US-listed healthcare (UNH, HUM) moves transmit weakly to Indonesian equities, so alpha is best sourced from idiosyncratic regulatory and demographic drivers rather than sector beta.

Trim PRIM into strength given its beta to US names. Maintain core exposure to SAME for domestic volume growth. Avoid chasing HUM; its move is sentiment-driven. Overall, stay neutral-weight, rotate into local operators with pricing power and volume visibility.
